narrative.overview: A continuous original porcelain works gives ordinary software responsibilities a spatial rhythm. Powder-blue space and soft miniature architecture lead; uncluttered white prose takes over when the visitor wants to read. No invented company proof or installation claims belong to the visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous process landscape; smooth scroll camera and four live inspectable phone chapter margins with historical still fallback.
Dense Barlow display forms and generous reading measures.
Ruled inline questions, not repeated boxed content.
dos: Do preserve the separate scenic and white-reading rhythms.
Do preserve complete mobile paragraphs, normal scrolling and real contact.
Do label scenery illustrative wherever it could imply real installations.
donts: Don't reuse source models, code, screenshots or business claims.
Don't turn independent software responsibilities into an agency-scale guarantee.
Don't canonize generic eyebrow/kicker styling from the sequence-specific labels.
